title: Rosalind and the Witness
author: Theo Vane
blurb: Noor Reyes, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
